neko.tabletMode.reason: Frozen AP receipt still has setting_key=null: native automaticMasterDetail follows size classes, while the original forced phone/tablet override has no key or provider. This portable policy remains unimplemented; automatic native layout does not supply a zero-valued Config setting.

evidence.note: neko.tabletMode: setting_key null and forced layout override explicitly not implemented

neko.typeface.reason: Frozen AP receipt still has setting_key=null: the bundled/system font-family selector has no native key/provider or supplied Android font assets. UIFont is only the native baseline; useSystemFont changes Dynamic Type size, and forceFontWeightFallback changes weight, so neither is this Boolean.

evidence.note: neko.typeface: exact family-selection parity explicitly absent

chats.cameraType.reason: Exact CameraType enum selects Android Camera1/Camera2/CameraX implementations. Native Legacy/Neo capture has different modes; these ordinals cannot select a native camera pipeline.

evidence.note: chats.cameraType native Legacy/Neo adaptation, no Android enum key

chats.unmuteWithVolumeButtons.reason: Exact contract consumes Android hardware-volume KeyEvents for unmute. This native client has no equivalent consumable hardware-key event; output-volume observation is not that event/override.
